title: Beast Clash
tagline: Pick three mythical beasts, then watch them fight.
summary: A small 3D auto battler. You choose three of nine mythical beasts, the game chooses three, and the two sides fight in real time while you move the camera.
description:
Beast Clash is a small 3D auto battler built with three.js. You pick **3 beasts** from a roster, the game picks 3 at random, and the two sides fight on their own in one arena. Your only control during a battle is the camera.

A battle runs in real time until one side has no beasts left. If 90 seconds pass first, the side with the higher total health percentage wins. Afterwards you see a damage summary for each beast and can rematch with the same picks or choose new ones.

The game also includes a **Bestiary**, a viewer where each beast plays its animations, effects and sounds, along with its stats and fighting style. There are two arenas: a stone arena lit by braziers, and a waterfall grotto in a forest clearing.
features: Nine beasts to choose from, with distinct roles and special abilities
Real-time fights with computer-controlled beasts on both sides
Orbit, side, top and overview cameras, plus a ride-along view behind any beast
Two arenas: Stone Arena and Waterfall Grotto
A Bestiary viewer with animations, effects, sounds and stats for every beast

controls.action: Rotate the camera around the arena
Jump to Overview, Side or Top view
